mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tighter monetary policy, leading to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher corporate revenues, positively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when HOUST increases by 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real savings indicates increased consumer purchasing power, leading to higher demand for goods and services, positively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of cases when RSAFS increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth indicates supply chain disruptions, leading to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO growth is below 0.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment and high payroll employment indicates a tight labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and higher interest rates, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS is above 150000, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth indicates reduced economic activity, leading to decreased corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when GDPC1 growth is below 1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate and rising consumer price index indicates stagflation, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 300, the hypothesis is rejected.
